//: Configuration for the static deployment of this directory (Vercel Project -> Root Directory: public). Everything the game needs is a file here: the page, its JS, /models, /sounds, /vendor/pyodide (the in-page Python engine) and /engine + /shared (that engine's code and data). There is no serverless function and no external backend -- the three /api/* endpoints the menu asks for are answered by the shim JSON in api/, and the match itself runs in the browser (js/local.js).

headers.//: Pyodide is fetched as a module (needs a JS MIME type) and as a 9 MB wasm binary: it must be cacheable, or every visit downloads it again.
The engine's own code and data change when the game does: revalidate instead of caching hard.
